data.name: Car Wash Together: Prologue - Early Days
data.detailed_description:
Car Cleaner Simulator Early Days is a free prologue to the full version of Car Cleaner Simulator.


Meet Clever Emma from Winston Springs, who will help you make your dream of a fabulously clean business come true. Cleaning vehicles inside and out can be both a real challenge and an exciting adventure. As your business grows day by day, gain new skills and tools to meet the expectations of even the most demanding customers.




Wouldn’t it be nice to expand your car wash in Winston Springs and become the biggest and best car wash in the whole region?

Start with a simple hand wash and a vacuum for upholstery...

…and then keep expanding with more and more car cleaning and detailing services.

In this game, the most important things are top-quality service for visiting cars, attention to speed and quality of work, and customer care.

This is just the beginning of the fun, not only for fans of business-themed simulators, but also for those looking for a relaxing and satisfying experience. The game lets you go from a worker at a small, old car wash to building your own large and perfect one, where service quality, efficiency, and your wallet depend entirely on your skills and strategy.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Microsoft Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 3.0 GHz or Ryzen 5 3000
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel arc B570 / GeForce GTX 970 / Radeon RX 570
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Microsoft Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 3.5 Ghz or Ryzen 7 5000 or higher
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel arc B580 / GeForce RTX 3070 / Radeon RX 6800
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
